versions.description: Production readiness release focused on truthful product surfaces, profile safety and layout integrity.

features: Version Center powered by a JSON release manifest.
Professional changelog timeline with search, filters, roadmap and developer notes.
New version popup with one-time persistence per release.
improvements: Marketplace now exposes only verified local theme packages and no fabricated social proof.
Sidebar chrome and empty states follow the active language consistently.
Release metadata now includes build, branch, status, environment and API version.
The existing local snapshot system remains available inside Version Center.
fixes: Profile normalization no longer contains account-specific cleanup or silent truncation.
Activity filters keep readable labels on laptop viewports.
Marketplace stays inside the application viewport without horizontal clipping.
QA safeguards no longer inject temporary content into lazy pages.
Command Palette no longer exposes unfinished release items or unsupported integrations.
Developer-specific example values were replaced by neutral production examples.
Authentication and profile surfaces now display the same release version.
Early runtime errors and unhandled rejections are retained for production diagnostics.
Login layout fit pass for small laptop screens.
Closed notification and AI session panels no longer stay visible or clickable off-screen.
Language switching now keeps the document language synchronized.
uiux: Version history redesigned as a premium release center.
Changelog sections use consistent ETHONE cards, filters and timeline states.
performance: Service Worker cache bumped so deployed users receive the latest files automatically.
Version data is lazy loaded and rendered progressively.
security: No service role keys or private build secrets are exposed in release metadata.
ai: AI page stability safeguards remain lazy-loaded and provider refresh is user-triggered.
integrations: Integration status can now be referenced in release notes without hardcoding UI changes.
widgets: Widget and dashboard changes can be tracked by category in future releases.
marketplace: Marketplace release changes are now first-class changelog categories.

versions.description: Final release audit focused on login reliability, PWA cache, responsive layout and console stability.

improvements: Auth page measured across desktop, tablet and mobile breakpoints.
PWA manifest, icons and Service Worker core assets verified.
fixes: Login card no longer clips social buttons on 1280x720.
Mobile auth layout scrolls only when content is taller than the viewport.
Preview mockup controls no longer behave like dead buttons.
performance: Critical files return HTTP 2xx locally before deployment.
JavaScript syntax checks pass across the project.
uiux: Auth page keeps premium split layout while improving small-screen accessibility.

versions.description: First Run Experience and What's New foundation for onboarding a user into ETHONE.

features: Premium onboarding with space, appearance, widgets, connections and Brain setup.
Settings and user menu entries to replay onboarding.
improvements: Initial dashboard can be generated from onboarding choices.
Onboarding progress survives refresh and can be resumed.
uiux: Full-screen onboarding shell with ETHONE visual identity.

versions.description: Personal OS interface foundation: dashboard, sidebar, AI page stability and core UI polish.

features: Activity, Health, Version History and Studio surfaces added to the OS navigation.
AI Core provider interface introduced with lazy tab rendering.
fixes: ETHONE AI page avoids automatic model refresh on navigation.
performance: Providers, logs and plugins are mounted only when their tab is opened.
Navigation wraps page render calls with safety guards.
uiux: Dashboard and sidebar moved closer to a native OS shell.
ai: ETHONE AI Core became the provider-neutral layer for future Brain features.
